name: Berserker
description: You are a brute forged in a world-sized meat grinder, where zombies are little more than an excuse to exercise your fists and enormous sword. Illiterate but brutally capable, you cut down the dead like firewood. Now you wear cursed armor that steadily takes hold of your mind. How did you get here? It hardly matters—in this hell, strength is your ticket to another day.

name: Berserk Fan
description: You reread every volume of Berserk while zombies hammered on your apartment door and decided: 'If Guts could do it, so can I!' You may lack his strength, but you have a homemade copy of his sword, a stylish hoodie, and a bandana—everything you need to look the part. In this apocalypse you have a DREAM, even if you do not have much of a chance. Perhaps one day you too will be free.
